cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then I wasn't really waiting for the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A goodbye that doesn't sound like you're already somewhere else. Have another sip.
